## Summary
- Close Cursor Bugbot notes from recent merges (#165 / #156):
  - Terminal remount: strip `pendingLive` overlap with the scrollback snapshot so attach no longer doubles the prompt.
  - Run painter: clearing one script no longer cancels the shared rAF (sibling pending lines still paint).
  - Setup: hydrate `getSetupLog` on worktree bind so mid-flight setup restores running chrome / the Setup tab.
- Record the rules in `.claude/skills/review/SKILL.md`.

## Test plan
- [ ] Remount Terminal while a shell is printing — no doubled prompt / repeated lines
- [ ] Two concurrent Run scripts; clear one — the other keeps painting
- [ ] Start setup, switch to another worktree then back — Setup tab shows live / running without needing a prior open
- [ ] `pnpm --filter @sideboard-ai/desktop test -- src/renderer/src/lib/xterm-scrollback-write.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/script-output-paint.test.ts`


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: fix: address leftover Bugbot notes on terminal and setup
